citation.authors: Jeong J, Zhu H, Harris RA, Dong Y et al

cited_by.title: Melatonin for sleep: what it does, dose and rules by country

record.population: Young adults in the Georgia Stress and Heart study: 71 African American and 79 European American
record.design: Cross-sectional study of overnight urinary melatonin (6-sulfatoxymelatonin) and 24-hour blood pressure
record.finding: After adjustment, African American participants had lower night-time melatonin excretion and higher night-time systolic blood pressure. Lower melatonin went with higher night-time blood pressure in both groups, and melatonin partly explained the group difference in pressure.
record.note: The body's own melatonin, not supplements. Group difference is a measured association in 150 young adults; the variable behind it is not known.
